usersLede: Who has an account and what they may do. Roles are grants, not settings: each one is recorded with who gave it and when. Registration is invite-only until collections ship.
inviteHint: They receive a link that lets them choose a password. The account starts with no roles at all — grant what they need afterwards.
inviteRejected: That address already has an account.
selfDemotionRefused: You cannot revoke your own admin role — ask another admin to do it.
